turns.text: Hi, I'm glad you're here! What answer did you get for how many bags Cecilia uses in the first year?
Nice, can you walk me through how you got that, starting with the first 180 days?
So the first 180 days is 180 cups. Then the rest of the year is 365 days times 2 cups, that's 730, so 910 total, and 910 divided by 110 is about 8.
When you multiplied 365 by 2, which days of the year were those 365 days covering?
Um, all the days in the year... oh wait, that includes the first 180 days, which were only 1 cup each.
Right, so how many days are left after the first 180?
Good. How many cups does the puppy eat over those 185 days?
Can you check that multiplication again, maybe splitting 185 into 100, 80 and 5?
Oh, 200 plus 160 plus 10 is 370. So 370 cups.
Great. What's the total number of cups for the whole first year?
And how could you turn 550 cups into a number of bags?
Divide by 110 since each bag has 110 cups, so it's 5 bags.
Yes! Can you explain why dividing works, and why you used 185 days instead of 365?
Dividing works because I'm seeing how many 110-cup bags fit into 550 cups. And I used 185 because the first 180 days were already counted at 1 cup.
